events.summary: Recent critiques have highlighted methodological errors in George Borjas' research on immigration, which often finds negative economic effects of immigration on native-born workers. When corrected, the anti-immigration conclusions of Borjas' work tend to disappear, casting doubt on his findings and suggesting that his methodologies are flawed.
events.title: Critique of George Borjas' Immigration Research
